plugins.name: legal-toolkit-from-andrea
plugins.description: A growing library of litigation skills: court-filing formatting (Texas state, New York, federal, Texas Business Court, AAA arbitration), PDF-to-text conversion, court-filing PDF renaming, calendar-true date checking, NY Tanbook citation formatting, offline Bankruptcy Code lookup, case-law research and memo drafting (CourtListener), a full AI cite-check pipeline (eyecite + CourtListener + Isaacus), a verbatim-source jury-charge drafter/auditor with machine-generated conditional routing (bring your own pattern-instruction library), and a shared first-run setup that tailors every skill to your machine, identity, and jurisdictions. Identity-, DMS-, and jurisdiction-agnostic.
